body.x: NALB Company I is planning to present the world top class ‘Computer Vision Solution at CES 2018(Consumer Technology Show), the world largest IT technology held in Las Vegas, USA, from 9th January(Tue) to 12th January (Fri).

NALBI is an AI company focusing on deep learning-based computer vision technology in embedded system and attends the event with the support from SeongNam Industry Promotion Agency. Its specific technologies Including segmentation are at world class level and NALBI Company has licensed its technology to the global APPs such as SNOW and B612 used by millions of people around the world.

NALBI Company has various knowledge of the Deep-Learning model design, pressing, pruning, optimizing and etc in the embedded system which requires low computing power. Especially, the Deep-Learning Inference Engine, self-developed engine, is optimized for Deep-Learning algorism to run faster in embedded system with low computing power. “Many manufacturers are looking for new opportunity through the Deep-Learning and NALBI Company has a commercialization experience of optimizing and applying the Deep-Learning algorism in a few resources such as embedded system” said a participator, adding “At CES, I would like to find a partner who is in need of accurate and fast Deep-learning algorism with limited resources such as IoT devices and autonomous vehicle.”

SeongNam Industry Promotion Agency was established in 2001 to contribute to enhancing corporate management and reinforcing competitiveness through comprehensive and systematic supports for small and medium-sized enterprises as well as venture businesses. The agency plays roles in planning & researching for new business development; operating the business center and over-all supports including management/technology/information/foundation/labor force; discovering overseas market and supporting export business; carrying out investment and association of investment for corporate activities.

The world largest IT exhibition, CES, held every January by CTA (Consumer technology Association) is the place where you can feel the world trend in the electronics industry. AVING NEWS is the global news network which broadcasted news the most about the top 3 technology exhibitions: CES (Consumer Technology Show), MWC (Mobile World Congress), and IFA (International Funkausstellung Berlin) for the past 11 years and this time they will also send dispatch a special press to broadcast issues on global markets and introduce major corporates from Korea.
